data.name: Fiendish Quarry
data.description: At 11th level, when a Tanglebriar demonslayer chooses an evil outsider as his quarry, he can tlie forgo the normal +2 attack bonus and instead treat his weapon as if it were good-aligned versus his quarry. This ability is otherwise identical to quarry and replaces that ability.
